mapper.sql: a.id, a.tenant_id, a.connection_id, a.app_code, a.app_name, a.client_id, a.agent_id, a.secret_mode, a.secret_cipher, a.secret_ref, a.secret_update_time, a.callback_token_cipher, a.encoding_aes_key_cipher, a.redirect_uri, a.scope, a.config_json, a.status, a.remark, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.create_dept, a.update_by, a.update_time, a.del_flag
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_social_capability_binding b INNER JOIN sys_social_app_config a ON a.id = b.app_config_id AND a.tenant_id = b.tenant_id AND a.del_flag = 0 AND a.status = 1 WHERE b.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND b.connection_id = #{connectionId} AND b.capability = #{capability} AND b.status = 1 AND b.del_flag = 0 ORDER BY b.update_time DESC, b.id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_social_app_config SET secret_cipher = #{newCipher}, secret_ref = #{newRef}, secret_mode = #{secretMode}, secret_update_time = NOW(), update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND del_flag = 0 AND ((#{expectedCipher} IS NULL AND secret_cipher IS NULL AND secret_ref IS NULL) OR COALESCE(secret_cipher, secret_ref) = #{expectedCipher})
